meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Cleans up Movy: trailer pop-ups, hero, home rows, posters, plots, scores and rankings
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-17, logged out, by fetching the server-rendered HTML of https://www.movy.sx/ (home), /movie/1368337, /tv/213375, /browse/movie and /help with a plain HTTP client, plus the site's public JS bundles for component class names and strings. Movy is a Next.js app with CSS-module class names (`HomeBanner-module-scss-module__<hash>__heroRoot`): the hash changes per build, so rules match `[class*="HomeBanner-module"][class*="__heroRoot"]` (component and local name), the `role`/`aria-label` of each row's `role="group"` track, `data-row`, `#you-may-like`, `#episodes-section` and button titles. The fixtures `home`, `movie` and `tv` (and their `desktop-` twins) are trimmed reconstructions of that markup; the site serves one responsive DOM to every viewer, so the pairs differ only in their header comment.

- **Verified in the markup:** every home row and its heading, hero and tabs, TOP 10 block, rank badges, card score spans, poster images (lazy `data-gate-src`), genre tiles, footer; on title pages the hero facts, badges, votes, CTA buttons, Cast section, `You may like` (a phone row and a desktop grid, both `#you-may-like`) and the episode toolbar. `trailerWrapper` is empty in the HTML; the bundle fills it with a muted, looping, autoplaying `<video>` on hover.
- **Not verified:** the player page (client-rendered, nothing to fetch without running the JS), server and subtitle pickers, Watch Party, profile and notification menus, search overlay and the Continue watching / Watchlist rows with real data (the HTML only has their `data-row` placeholders). No rule targets them.
- **Cookie banners, ads and app banners** are the original generic rules and still use the synthetic fixtures `synthetic.html` / `desktop-synthetic.html`: none of the fetched pages contained a consent dialog, ad slot or app banner. Movy's help page says it shows ads and that blocking them can break playback; the site has its own Show ads switch in settings.
- Hiding a trailer preview or a row does not stop the page loading it. Score hiding leaves the `·` separator before the year on cards. The home hero rule scopes itself with `:has(> section...__billboard)` because title pages reuse the same `heroRoot` class for their header and Play button.
